diagnosis: The endpoint requires the 'profile:view' OAuth2 scope, but allows passing any target_user_id via query parameters without confirming that target_user_id equals token.user_id. An OAuth application granted permission to view the authorizing user's profile can scrape full activity histories for any user on the platform.
exploit_request:
GET /users/activity-summary?target_user_id=4091 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <oauth_token>
